messages.content: I need to migrate our CI/CD pipeline for the auth-service from Jenkins to GitHub Actions. Can you analyze the current setup and create a plan for this migration?

content.text: I'll read the Jenkinsfile to understand the current build, test, and deployment stages.
Based on the Jenkinsfile, I've identified the necessary steps for migration. I'll now create a series of tasks to track the implementation of the GitHub Actions workflows.

input.subject: Implement CI Workflow
input.description: Create a GitHub Action workflow (.github/workflows/ci.yml) that runs linting, tests, and builds on pull requests and pushes to main/develop.

input.subject: Implement CD Workflow
input.description: Create a GitHub Action workflow (.github/workflows/cd.yml) for automated deployment to staging and production environments using existing scripts.

input.subject: Decommission Jenkins Pipeline
input.description: Verify the new GitHub Actions workflows and disable the corresponding Jenkins job once confirmed.

content.text: I'll start by claiming the first task to begin the implementation of the CI workflow.

I have analyzed the current Jenkins setup and broken the migration into three trackable tasks. I've started on the first task: implementing the CI workflow for linting, testing, and building.
